identitySignals: Name matches a registered nonprofit: 'Victor Treatment Centers Inc', EIN 94-2264395, located in Chico, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), matching the agenda's 'Victor Treatment Center' and 'Chico, CA'
Victor's North Valley School page says North Valley School is the non-public school affiliated with Victor Treatment Centers, matching the 'dba North Valley School' in the agenda

North Valley School is described as a private, non-profit, non-public school for grades 1-12 with educational and mental health services, matching OUSD's nonpublic school special education master contract
research.notes: North Valley School operates in Santa Rosa, CA (per victor.org); the agenda's Chico location matches the Victor Treatment Centers Inc registry address. Victor Treatment Centers is distinct from Victor Community Support Services (separate nonprofit, EIN 43-1959837). Phone, email and mailing address omitted because no clear main-line contact for the legal entity was confirmed; victor.org lists only regional office and school numbers. CA entity number and SAM UEI not looked up.

profile.summary: Victor Treatment Centers is a nonprofit that provides mental health services and residential treatment for children and youth in California. It operates North Valley School, a private, non-profit, non-public school for grades 1-12 that provides educational and mental health services in small classes for students who need specialized support.

sources.title: Victor Treatment Centers Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: ProPublica confirms Victor Treatment Centers Inc is a 501(c)(3) residential mental-health treatment nonprofit in Chico, EIN 94-2264395, and victor.org confirms North Valley School is its private nonprofit non-public school for grades 1-12 serving IEP students, matching the agenda's dba and the nonpublic school special education contract. The summary is neutral and supported; the Santa Rosa school address differs from the Chico registry address but is noted by the researcher and is consistent with one organization.
